# Keep channel preference units and temporary update lockout scope explicit

The update.timestamp port configured release lockout duration in milliseconds and badge wait time in seconds, with Nightly set to zero. Its comment warns that inconsistent profile preferences are dangerous. Accepted channel source retains badge delays but no longer has these multiSessionInstallLockout preferences. When reviewing a similar port, state the units and all channel overrides; do not copy the historical numeric magnitude or treat this old lockout setting as current policy. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Update channel preference units.
